description: The line plot illustrates the performance of three data sources—Tutorials (blue), Library Documentation (red), and Github files (green)—as measured against the number of tokens, which ranges from 200 to 1000 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled with no explicit unit but scaled from 10 to 40, represents a performance metric (likely accuracy or F1 score) that varies across the token counts. The blue line for Tutorials starts at approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rises steadily to around 29 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to about 28 at 1000 tokens. The red line for Library Documentation begins at 26, increases to 30 at 500 tokens, peaks at 33 at 800 tokens, and drops to 27 at 1000 tokens. The green line for Github files starts at 28, rises to 31 at 500 tokens, peaks at 33 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to 30 at 1000 tokens. A fourth yellow line, unlabeled in the legend but visually present, starts at 33 at 200 tokens, declines sharply to 19 at 800 tokens, and continues down to 11 at 1000 tokens, suggesting a contrasting trend compared to the other three sources.
